To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we propose a theoretical framework of a text mining enhanced approach for energy demand forecasting and we demonstrate the proposed approach for sentiment analyses with experimental results.
the proposed framework can be used to analyze news articles and to extract sentiments from a series of reports, and to use the magnitudes of the sentiment to compose an event pattern.
a new approach to energy demand forecasting that incorporates text mining can be used to identify the impact of special events on demand.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a framework to incorporate the text mining approach for energy demand forecasting.
the development of a theoretical framework for integrating text mining and forecasting to accommodate the short-term variations in the energy demand and price.
the development of a framework that can be used to integrate the text mining and energy demand forecasting.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the text mining approach is useful for energy demand forecasting and that it is a valuable tool for the development of a new forecasting approach.
this paper presents an integrated framework for energy demand forecasting by combining text mining and time series forecasting.
the proposed approach is a useful tool for forecasting short-term variations in demand and/or price.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have developed a new approach to integrate text mining and forecasting for short-term demand and price forecasting, which can be used in the energy industry to enhance their forecasting capability and improve the efficiency of energy supply.
the proposed approach can be used to identify and quantify the impact of special events on energy demand and to provide a new perspective to the energy industry and policy makers.
the proposed approach provides a new perspective to understand the impact of a special event on energy demand or prices.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the text mining and sentiment analysis approach is useful to identify short-term demand variation and price spikes.
news articles can be used as an input for demand forecasting models, especially in short-term demand forecasting.
news articles can be used to extract information that is not available from other sources, and that the extracted information can be used to improve energy demand forecasting.
